import math

# Data values (in millions)
value_2011 = 135030
value_2019 = 35810

# Number of years from FY 2011 to FY 2019
n_years = 2019 - 2011  # 8 years

# 1. CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate)
# CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (value_2019 / value_2011) ** (1.0 / n_years) - 1

# 2. Annual Decay Factor
# This is the average annual rate at which the value decreases
# Using the same formula but focusing on decay
# Annual decay factor = 1 - CAGR (when CAGR is negative)
# More precisely, it's the average annual multiplier
annual_decay_factor = (value_2019 / value_2011) ** (1.0 / n_years)

# 3. Arc Elasticity (using midpoint percentage change)
# Arc elasticity = (ΔY/Y) / (ΔX/X) using midpoint
# Here Y is outlays, X is time
# Percentage change in Y = (Y2 - Y1) / ((Y1 + Y2)/2)
# Percentage change in X = (X2 - X1) / ((X1 + X2)/2)

Y1, Y2 = value_2011, value_2019
X1, X2 = 2011, 2019

# Using midpoint formula:
pct_change_Y = (Y2 - Y1) / ((Y1 + Y2) / 2)
pct_change_X = (X2 - X1) / ((X1 + X2) / 2)

arc_elasticity = pct_change_Y / pct_change_X

print(f"FY 2011 value: {value_2011}")
print(f"FY 2019 value: {value_2019}")
print(f"Number of years: {n_years}")
print(f"\nCAGR: {cagr:.10f}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {annual_decay_factor:.10f}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity:.10f}")

print("\n--- Rounded to 3 decimal places ---")
print(f"CAGR (rounded): {round(cagr, 3)}")
print(f"Annual decay factor (rounded): {round(annual_decay_factor, 3)}")
print(f"Arc elasticity (rounded): {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")
EOF
